players.product: Enterprise SATA SSDs, PCIe SSDs and RDIMM modules for AI servers and data centers; mSSD and embedded storage

quarterly_data.signal: 2025 annual report: revenue RMB 22,766,169,990.55 (RMB 227.66 hundred million), up 30.36% year over year; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 1,423,298,162.88 (RMB 14.23 hundred million), up 185.41%; net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 1,289,178,618.90, up 674.08%; operating cash flow RMB -1,201,201,037.10. The company says 2025 revenue was the highest for any comparable period since its listing.
quarterly_data.figure: 2025 revenue RMB 227.66 hundred million (+30.36%); net profit RMB 14.23 hundred million (+185.41%); net profit excl. non-recurring +674.08%

quarterly_data.signal: 2025 revenue by product: embedded storage RMB 10,012,075,974.67 (43.98% of revenue, up 18.83%, gross margin 17.94%); solid-state drives RMB 5,569,595,868.51 (24.46%, up 34.31%, gross margin 15.49%); mobile storage RMB 4,894,012,888.82 (21.50%, up 52.56%, gross margin 29.77%); memory modules RMB 2,216,493,727.54 (9.74%, up 45.15%). Storage-industry gross margin 19.40% (up 0.35 points). Overseas revenue RMB 15,218,295,630.52 (66.85% of revenue, up 22.48%), domestic RMB 7,547,874,360.03 (up 49.79%); direct sales 63.95% of revenue. Direct materials were 88.14% of operating cost.
quarterly_data.figure: SSD revenue RMB 5,569,595,868.51 (+34.31%); memory modules RMB 2,216,493,727.54 (+45.15%); gross margin 19.40%

quarterly_data.signal: 2025 annual report: enterprise storage revenue reached RMB 17.83 hundred million, up 93.30%; the company says its enterprise storage products have been introduced into the supply chains of some leading internet companies and server makers, and that it is one of few domestic companies able to design, combine and supply eSSD plus RDIMM at scale.
quarterly_data.figure: enterprise storage revenue RMB 17.83 hundred million (+93.30%)

quarterly_data.signal: 2025 annual report: Lexar brand global sales revenue RMB 47.41 hundred million, up 34.53% (from RMB 8.64 hundred million in 2019, a 32.81% compound annual growth rate); Brazilian subsidiary Zilia sales revenue RMB 29.24 hundred million, up 26.49%.
quarterly_data.figure: Lexar RMB 47.41 hundred million (+34.53%); Zilia RMB 29.24 hundred million (+26.49%)

quarterly_data.signal: 2025 annual report: storage products sales volume 48,316 ten-thousand units (down 2.04%), output 49,325 ten-thousand units (down 5.59%), year-end inventory 11,524 ten-thousand units (up 8.07%).

2025 annual report: the full series of its in-house controller chips reached volume deployment of over 1.4 hundred million units in 2025. Its self-developed 5nm UFS 4.1 controller has been introduced into the supply chains of several leading smartphone makers, and the company says UFS 4.1 products carrying its own controller will fully enter a scaled volume ramp in 2026; it also says its mSSD has won recognition from many leading PC makers and will reach scaled commercial use in 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: over 1.4 hundred million controller chips deployed in 2025

quarterly_data.signal: 2025 annual report products: its SPU chip (WM8500, PCIe 5.0) reaches NAND I/O of 4800MT/s and supports a single-SSD capacity of up to 128TB (company internal tests), and is adapted to its HLC technology; its UFS 4.1 controller (WM7400) uses a 5nm process. In enterprise memory it offers DDR5 RDIMM up to 256GB, has lit up SOCAMM (LPDDR5X, 128-bit I/O, up to 128GB per module) and completed development and validation of 8800/12800 MRDIMM up to 256GB; its enterprise eSSD covers 480GB to 7.68TB. The ePOP5x launched at CES 2026 and MWC 2026 (as thin as 0.52mm, DRAM rate 8533Mbps) is in solution adaptation, customer validation and market introduction.
quarterly_data.figure: SPU NAND I/O 4800MT/s; up to 128TB SSD; MRDIMM up to 256GB

quarterly_data.signal: 2025 annual report: top five customers were 28.96% of 2025 sales (RMB 6,593,526,982.34); the largest 7.58%, then 6.53%, 5.75%, 4.76% and 4.34%; names not disclosed; 1.36% of sales from related parties among them.
quarterly_data.figure: top five customers 28.96% of 2025 sales; largest 7.58%

quarterly_data.signal: 2025 annual report: top five suppliers were 52.01% of 2025 purchases (RMB 11,552,986,597.10); the largest 14.51%, then 13.40%, 8.57%, 8.28% and 7.25%; names not disclosed; no related-party purchases among them. The company says its main raw material is storage wafers.
quarterly_data.figure: top five suppliers 52.01% of 2025 purchases; largest 14.51%

quarterly_data.signal: 2025 annual report: R&D spending RMB 1,047,823,664.47, up 15.11%, 4.60% of revenue (5.21% in 2024), none capitalized; 1,240 R&D staff at year-end. Projects include high-end storage for AI (next-generation enterprise SSD and enterprise RDIMM for servers; PCIe SSD and DIMM for AI devices), controller chips (WM8500 architecture design completed), small-capacity SLC / MLC NAND and NOR flash chips, and automotive and flagship LPDDR5X.

2025 annual report: inventory book value RMB 11,677,745,416.17 at end-2025 (51.33% of total assets, up from RMB 7,833,153,366.75), or 70.31% of current assets; 2025 inventory write-down provisions RMB 313,660,594.99. Contract liabilities rose to RMB 354,635,038.81 mainly on higher customer prepayments.

2025 annual report: the company says it has long-term strategic cooperation with the main upstream storage wafer makers and is one of the few memory companies worldwide with long-term strategic direct supply agreements with several wafer makers; it names Micron, Samsung and SK Hynix as its main suppliers.

2025 annual report: on 2025-06-16 its wholly owned subsidiary Longsys Electronics (HK) signed a binding memorandum of understanding with Sandisk Technologies, Inc. to launch customized UFS products and solutions for the mobile and IoT markets, combining Longsys' controller, firmware and packaging and test capabilities with Sandisk's NAND flash technology; the company says it has reached UFS 4.1 cooperation with several wafer makers including Sandisk and with several leading smartphone makers; the agreement was being performed normally at year-end.

2025 annual report: Maxio Technology (Hangzhou), a platform chip designer of data-storage controller chips and AIoT signal processing and transmission chips, is an associate (equity investee) of Longsys.

2025 annual report construction in progress: cumulative investment in the Longsys Group Shanghai headquarters project reached 118.24% of budget and in the Zhongshan storage industrial park phase II (storage R&D and testing) 96.21%, both largely transferred to fixed assets in 2025, cutting construction in progress to RMB 58,765,482.19; the raised-fund Zhongshan phase II project reached its intended usable state and was closed.
quarterly_data.figure: Zhongshan phase II at 96.21% of budget

quarterly_data.signal: 2025 annual report business plan: facing continued price increases and supply shortage in the semiconductor storage market, the company plans to deepen its position in AI storage, high-end storage, its own brands and overseas markets; to increase R&D spending on next-generation controller chips and high-end storage products; to focus on device-side AI, AI server and embodied-intelligence applications; and to make targeted investments in its main plants in Suzhou, Zhongshan and Brazil to strategically expand its packaging and testing capacity.
